description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family, with the horizontal axis displaying categories labeled as language families — IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic — arranged sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect' and ranges from 0 to 40 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each language family category contains six grouped bars representing different models or configurations: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). For the IE-Indic group, the tallest bars are mBERT-R₂ and mBERT-B₂, both reaching approximately 20–25 effect units, with mBERT-B₂ slightly higher; the shortest bars are mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂, both near 0 effect units. In the IE-Germanic group, the bars increase steadily from mBERT-L₂ (~5) to XLM-B₂ (~15). For IE-Baltic, the effect values decline slightly from mBERT-L₂ (~3) to XLM-B₂ (~4). The Semitic group shows the greatest variability, with error bars spanning from approximately -10 to 25, and the tallest bar is XLM-B₂ at around 20 effect units. The Uralic group shows the lowest effect values, with all bars below 5, and the tallest bar is XLM-B₂ at approximately 3 effect units. The Isolate group shows minimal effect, with all bars near 0 effect units. Error bars indicate standard deviation, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and height.
